blocks.text: Setting up your appraisal workbook on Mac

Your appraisal workbook needs to be clean and predictable. Start by organizing your sheets by property type or region. Use consistent headers in row 1 for every sheet. This makes it easier to use functions like XLOOKUP or pivot tables later. Always freeze your top row so your headers stay visible while you scroll. Go to View > Freeze Panes > Freeze Top Row to do this.

Comparing sales requires accurate data. Avoid manual entry errors by using Data Validation. Select the cells where you enter property types. Go to Data > Data Validation. Choose List from the Allow menu. Type your options like Single Family, Condo, or Multi Family. This prevents typos that break your formulas.
Excel keyboard shortcuts for Mac appraisers

items: Fn + F2: Edit the active cell quickly.
Shift + Space: Select the entire row.
Ctrl + Space: Select the entire column.
Cmd + D: Fill down the formula from the cell above.
Cmd + T: Convert your selection into a formal Excel table.

blocks.text: Tables are better than ranges. They expand automatically when you add new comparable sales. They also keep your formatting consistent. If you use a table, you can refer to columns by name instead of cell addresses. This makes your formulas much easier to read and debug.

Many appraisers struggle when Excel treats numbers as text. This happens often when importing data from CSV files. If your math is not working, check if your numbers are aligned to the left. Numbers should align to the right. Use the Text to Columns feature to convert these back to numbers. You can also use the VALUE function to force a conversion.
Using Lazur to work faster in Excel

Lazur helps you stay in your flow. If you forget where a specific setting is, hold Option + Command and ask. Lazur will point at the menu item for you. If you need to write a complex adjustment formula, ask Lazur to explain the syntax. You can also use Lazur to dictate notes directly into your cells. This is perfect for quick comments on property conditions.

faq.question: Can I run Excel for Mac on Apple Silicon?
faq.answer: Yes, Microsoft Excel for Mac is fully optimized for Apple Silicon and runs natively on M1, M2, and M3 chips.

faq.question: Does Lazur edit my Excel files?
faq.answer: No. Lazur does not click buttons or edit your files. It guides you and answers questions so you can perform the actions yourself.

faq.question: How do I fix the leading zero issue in Excel?
faq.answer: Format your cells as Text before you type the data. Select the cells, go to Home > Number Format, and choose Text.
